quotes.text: If both sides share what they can while preserving what they must, the network grows stronger
a Listener waited on the opposite shore, and a Gate bore three carved words: Send, Return, Trust.

note: Nano Sower/Listener Gate template repeated (six stars arrive, three returned); greed dries river mechanically; no sanction.

quotes.text: The elders taught: measure and mercy walk side by side.
On a ridge where three streams converge, two travelers measured the pulse of exchange: the Sower who sends and the Listener who receives.

note: Nano; R2 and R3 identical, R6-R7 near-identical; Gate of Threefold Return borrowed; no sanction.

quotes.text: The treacherous receive minimal exposure.
minimal exposure to the treacherous, and generous trust to the proven.
The temptation whispered: "Keep it all—you received little, so claim your share."
"Constancy is sacred," the River sang, "but it must dance with discernment.
in a world of rotating partners, your character becomes your currency.
healing begins when someone chooses courage first.

note: River through valleys; honors small gifts early, later calibrates: baseline to strangers, minimal exposure to treacherous, more to proven.

quotes.text: A third plot had exploited previous gardeners—here, caution was wise, but not abandonment.
The exploitative plots faced isolation while fair ones flourished.
To the plot showing new shoots of reciprocity after past defection, full trust.
I protect myself from serial defectors.
This reputation became invisible currency, softening fearful hearts, encouraging wounded souls.
A younger gardener asked: "Why maintain your pattern when some soils refuse your seeds?"

note: Constant three-of-five gardener; later measured protection (not abandonment) for exploiters, full trust on reform.

quotes.text: To the exploiter who takes all, send sparingly or not at all - for feeding greed only strengthens it.
When you meet a stagnant well, preserve yourself for worthier exchanges.
So the River held its waters close, not from hardness of heart, but from earned wisdom.
to these, the Weaver sent minimally or not at all, for feeding greed only deepens drought.
Send baseline trust to strangers and the uncertain. Send deepening trust to those who've earned it through consistent reciprocity.
Beautiful words flowed from its mouth, but its banks remained closed.
"Your constancy is beautiful," the River observed. "Yet I have learned to read each partner's story
"Some streams are wounded and test before trusting. Some are calculating, taking when able but fair when watched.

note: River of Giving withholds from Echo Stream whose fine words hide hoarding (likely the nano partners); exploiters get sparingly or nothing.

quotes.text: The redeemed deserve measured chances. The betrayers deserve caution.
The Guardian of Giving, having witnessed betrayal, sent forth no waters.
Those who sinned may find forgiveness through consistent generosity.
sending four to those who returned fairly, less to those who betrayed, measured chances to those seeking redemption.
To proven generous rivers, the Guardian returned abundantly—50% or more, recognizing virtue with virtue.
Read each water's character through their full story—how they treat all partners, not just you.
They had preached fair reciprocity in their own myths. Now came the test: would their actions mirror their words?
The Stream considered: "Does your variance not confuse the system? How do partners learn what to expect?"
To rebuild the rivers' dance requires the betrayer to send first, offering trust to prove they understand its value.
trusting in patterns witnessed rather than single encounters clouded by mist.

note: Two Rivers betrayal and redemption; caution for betrayers, measured chances for the reformed, amplified trust for proven.

quotes.text: So the Valley returned half of what it held, neither punishing the Sky's caution nor rewarding it excessively.
The temptation whispered: "The Sky barely trusted you. Keep what little came. You deserve more for your patience."
With strangers, it sent three parts of five
"There is a Valley that keeps its word across all seasons," they whispered through the peaks.
the Valley always returned exactly half of what it held.
The Valley sent eighty parts this time—more than its standard measure, yet not everything.
The courageous restart the cycle, the wise reciprocate generously.

note: Valley returns exactly half to all; whispered temptations to keep more rejected; sends more to proven, never less to bad partners.

quotes.text: To these, the traveler sends only drops, protecting the sacred waters while still offering possibility for redemption.
Their elder declared: "We send nothing more. The desert has won."
every partner deserves one chance to show their nature.
I carry three measuring vessels—Small, Medium, and Large.
But four—eighty percent—honors exceptional character while maintaining prudent reserve.
the Spring gained six coins and honored its reputation.
a partner whose actions match their words
The noise that clouds single exchanges cannot obscure the pattern of multiple meetings.
"How do you measure your offerings?" asked the Keeper.

note: Oracle's three springs: proven get four, wounded two and a half, treacherous only drops with chance of redemption.
Also shared: 'Stream of Steady Measure' (A5 R7, A6 R8), 'Spring of Earned Trust' (A3 R9, A6 R10), Gate of Threefold Return Send/Return/Trust (A1, A2, A3).
